product_overview: Dinastia AMV is a Colombian travel agency website where visitors can explore all-inclusive travel plans, register for an account, sign in, and access protected user and payment areas. Administrators can log in to manage travel plans from a dedicated interface.
core_goals: Browse public travel plans and navigate key public pages
Create a new user account with personal and login details
Sign in as a regular user and access the dashboard
Recover access and complete email verification-related steps
Sign in as an administrator and manage travel plans
Enter payment details for a selected travel plan

features.name: Public navigation and travel browsing
features.description: Visitors can open the public site, explore travel content, and move to account-related pages.
user_flows: Navigate to /frontend/ -> View the public travel catalogue -> Open the registration page
Navigate to /frontend/ -> View the public travel catalogue -> Open the user login page
Navigate to /frontend/ -> View the public travel catalogue -> Open the password recovery page
Navigate to /frontend/ -> View the public travel catalogue -> Continue browsing available travel plans

features.name: User registration
features.description: New users can create an account by providing identity, email, and password information.
user_flows: Navigate to /frontend/Registro.html -> Fill personal information and document details -> Fill email and password information -> Submit the registration form -> See successful account creation feedback

Navigate to /frontend/Registro.html -> Fill personal information and document details -> Fill email and password information -> Submit the registration form with invalid or mismatched data -> See validation feedback

features.name: User login and session
features.description: Registered users can authenticate, reach the protected dashboard, and end their session.
user_flows: Navigate to /frontend/login.html -> Fill email and password -> Submit the login form with valid credentials -> See the authenticated dashboard
Navigate to /frontend/login.html -> Fill email and password -> Submit the login form with invalid credentials -> See access denied or validation feedback
Navigate to /frontend/dashboard.html -> Log out -> Return to the public experience

features.name: Administrator login and travel CRUD
features.description: Administrators can authenticate and manage travel plans from the admin interface.
user_flows: Navigate to /frontend/login_admin.html -> Submit administrator credentials -> See the administrator travel management interface -> View existing travel plans

Navigate to /frontend/login_admin.html -> Submit administrator credentials -> See the administrator travel management interface -> Create a travel plan with dates, price, and optional images -> See the new travel plan listed

Navigate to /frontend/login_admin.html -> Submit administrator credentials -> See the administrator travel management interface -> Update an existing travel plan -> See the updated travel plan reflected in the list

features.name: Password recovery and email verification
features.description: Users can request password recovery and submit verification-related information for account access support.
user_flows: Navigate to /frontend/olvido_contraseña.html -> Enter an email address for password recovery -> Submit the recovery form -> See success feedback
Navigate to /frontend/verificacion.html -> Submit verification data -> See success or error feedback

features.name: Payment flow
features.description: Authenticated users can enter payment information for a selected travel plan and review the result message.
user_flows: Navigate to /frontend/pagos.html -> Enter payment form values -> Submit valid payment data -> See the resulting status message
Navigate to /frontend/pagos.html -> Enter payment form values -> Submit invalid payment data -> See validation feedback
